data.topic_description: Explore cleaner ways to get from A to B.

questions.quiz_ques_text: Which option has the lowest emissions per kilometre?

options.quiz_option_text: Driving alone in a petrol car
options.quiz_option_explanation: Cars are convenient but not the lowest emission choice.
Public transport spreads emissions across many passengers.
Flights have a high climate impact per kilometre.

questions.quiz_ques_text: What’s a realistic first step towards cleaner commuting?

options.quiz_option_text: Walk or cycle one day per week
options.quiz_option_explanation: Starting small makes the habit more sustainable.
Great if it works for you, but not realistic for most people overnight.

data.topic_description: Learn how everyday food choices add up.

questions.quiz_ques_text: Which weekly change has the biggest impact?

options.quiz_option_text: Swapping one beef meal for a plant-based option
options.quiz_option_explanation: Beef has a high footprint; even one swap a week helps.
